comment: Game-data record layouts the reader needs that have moved between patches. Hex strings are byte offsets. Values here were hard-coded in Catalogue.cs before 2026-11-13 and are unchanged.

dropSet.comment: dropsetinfo record, offsets from the record key (after the length-prefixed comment). Entry offsets are from the entry start.

skillSlots.comment: characterinfo: skill key is keyBeforeMarker bytes before the first FF FF FF FF 00x8 A0 86 01 00 marker of each slot run; runs are minGap..maxGap bytes apart.
